SELECT seqReservation.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO tblReservation ( reservation_id, user_id, user_route_id, status_id, reservation_price, reservation_start_date, reservation_end_date -- reservation_regdate는 DEFAULT SYSDATE 사용 ) VALUES ( #{reservationId}, #{userId}, #{userRouteId}, NVL(#{statusId}, 1), #{reservationPrice}, TO_DATE(#{reservationStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{reservationEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') )

SELECT seqAccomReservation.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO tblAccomReservation ( accom_reservation_id, room_id, reservation_id, user_route_id, status_id, guest_count, room_total_price, checkin_date, checkout_date, accom_notes ) VALUES ( #{accomReservationId}, #{roomId}, #{reservationId}, #{userRouteId}, #{statusId}, #{guestCount}, #{roomTotalPrice}, TO_DATE(#{checkinDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{checkoutDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{accomNotes, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

SELECT seqCarReservation.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO tblCarReservation ( car_reservation_id, car_id, reservation_id, user_route_id, status_id, pickup_date, dropoff_date, pickup_location, dropoff_location, car_total_price, car_notes javax.el.PropertyNotFoundException: [roomName] 특성이 [com.project.trip.reservation.model.AccomReservationDTO] 유형에 없습니다. javax.el.BeanELResolver$BeanProperties.g ) VALUES ( #{carReservationId}, #{carId}, #{reservationId}, #{userRouteId}, #{statusId}, TO_DATE(#{pickupDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{dropoffDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{pickupLocation, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dropoffLocation, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{carTotalPrice}, #{carNotes, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT reservation_id AS reservationId, user_id AS userId, user_route_id AS userRouteId, status_id AS statusId, reservation_price AS reservationPrice, TO_CHAR(reservation_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reservationStartDate, TO_CHAR(reservation_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reservationEndDate FROM tblReservation WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId}

SELECT ar.accom_reservation_id AS accomReservationId, ar.room_id AS roomId, ar.user_route_id AS userRouteId, ar.status_id AS statusId, ar.guest_count AS guestCount, ar.room_total_price AS roomTotalPrice, TO_CHAR(ar.checkin_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS checkinDate, TO_CHAR(ar.checkout_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS checkoutDate, ar.accom_notes AS accomNotes, ar.reservation_id AS reservationId, p.place_name AS accomName, r.room_name AS roomName FROM tblAccomReservation ar JOIN tblAccomRoom r ON ar.room_id = r.room_id JOIN tblAccom a ON r.accom_id = a.accom_id JOIN tblPlace p ON a.place_id = p.place_id WHERE ar.reservation_id = #{reservationId}

SELECT cr.car_reservation_id AS carReservationId, cr.car_id AS carId, cr.reservation_id AS reservationId, cr.user_route_id AS userRouteId, cr.status_id AS statusId, TO_CHAR(cr.pickup_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pickupDate, TO_CHAR(cr.dropoff_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dropoffDate, cr.pickup_location AS pickupLocation, cr.dropoff_location AS dropoffLocation, cr.car_total_price AS carTotalPrice, cr.car_notes AS carNotes, c.car_name AS carName FROM tblCarReservation cr JOIN tblRentalCar c ON cr.car_id = c.car_id WHERE cr.reservation_id = #{reservationId}

SELECT r.room_id AS roomId, a.accom_id AS accomId, p.place_name AS accomName, r.room_name AS roomName, r.price_per_night AS pricePerNight, p.place_address AS address, p.place_lat AS lat, p.place_lng AS lng, r.room_image_url AS imageUrl FROM tblPlaceLocation pl JOIN tblPlace p ON p.place_location_id = pl.place_location_id JOIN tblAccom a ON a.place_id = p.place_id JOIN tblAccomRoom r ON r.accom_id = a.accom_id WHERE pl.place_location_name = #{region} ORDER BY p.place_name, r.room_name
